articles.summary: Expands Service Center presence in Michigan Enhances end market exposure with food beverage, automotive, aggregates, waste water treatment Adds scale, new geography, and multi-channel capabilities DXP Enterprises, Inc. (NASDAQ: DXPE) today announced that it completed the acquisition of MDS of Michigan, Inc. (“MDS of Michigan” or the “Company”) on November 2, 2026. Founded in 1984, MDS of Michigan is headquartered in Jenison, Michigan and serves customers in the food beverage, automotive, aggregates, and waste water treatment industries. MDS of Michigan is a leading multi-channel distributor of bearings power transmission, and related products and services. DXP funded the acquisition with cash from the balance sheet. David Little, Chairman, and Chief Executive Officer of DXP commented, “We are pleased to welcome MDS of Michigan to the DXP family. articles.title: DXP Enterprises, Inc. Announces Acquisition of MDS of Michigan, Inc.
